headline: Wall Street Falls Ahead of Nvidia's Quarterly Report
summary: US stocks fell as investors reacted to comments from Federal Reserve officials while awaiting Nvidia's quarterly earnings report. Nvidia's results are a key read on AI chip demand.
why: Nvidia is the leading maker of AI accelerator chips, so its earnings are closely watched as a gauge of demand across the technology sector.

impacts.name: Nvidia
impacts.why: Investors were positioning ahead of Nvidia's quarterly earnings release.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
